156                public SwarmMember(Vector2f startingLoc, RoilingSwarmParams params, CombatEntityAPI attachedTo) {
157                        //sprite = Global.getSettings().getSprite("misc", "nebula_particles");
158                        //fx_particles2 - swirly
159                        // nebula_particles2 - smooth, but 2x2
160                        // dust_particles - smooth
161                        
162                        sprite = Global.getSettings().getSprite(params.spriteCat, params.spriteKey);
163                        float i = Misc.random.nextInt(4);
164                        float j = Misc.random.nextInt(4);
165                        sprite.setTexWidth(0.25f);
166                        sprite.setTexHeight(0.25f);
167                        sprite.setTexX(i * 0.25f);
168                        sprite.setTexY(j * 0.25f);
169                        
170                        //sprite.setAdditiveBlend();
171                        sprite.setNormalBlend();
172                        
173                        angle = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
174                        
175                        
176                        rollOffset(params, attachedTo);
177                        
178                        Vector2f spawnOffset = new Vector2f(offset);
179                        spawnOffset.scale(params.spawnOffsetMult);
180                        if (params.spawnOffsetMult != 0) {
181                                spawnOffset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(spawnOffset, attachedTo.getFacing());
182                        }
183                        
184                        Vector2f.add(startingLoc, spawnOffset, loc);
185                        
186                        vel = Misc.getPointWithinRadius(new Vector2f(), params.maxSpeed * 0.25f);
187                        
188//                      params.maxSpeed = 1200;
189//                      vel = new Vector2f(0, -1400f);
190//                      Vector2f.add(startingLoc, new Vector2f(0, 500f), loc);
191                        
192                        dur = params.baseDur + (float) Math.random() * params.durRange;
193                        scale = 1f;
194                        
195                        turnRate = Math.signum((float) Math.random() - 0.5f) * params.maxTurnRate * (float) Math.random();
196                        
197                        fader = new FaderUtil(0f, 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f,
198                                                        params.minFadeoutTime + (params.maxFadeoutTime - params.minFadeoutTime) * (float) Math.random());
199                        fader.fadeIn();
200                        
201                        scaler = new FaderUtil(0f, 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f, 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f);
202                        scaler.setBounce(true, true);
203                        scaler.fadeIn();
204                        
205                }
206                
207                public void rollOffset(RoilingSwarmParams params, CombatEntityAPI attachedTo) {
208                        if (params.generateOffsetAroundAttachedEntityOval && attachedTo instanceof ShipAPI) {
209                                ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) attachedTo;
210                                
211                                float angle = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
212                                Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
213                                Vector2f from = new Vector2f(dir);
214                                from.scale(ship.getCollisionRadius() + 1000f);
215                                Vector2f.add(from, ship.getLocation(), from);
216                                
217                                float min = Misc.getTargetingRadius(from, ship, false);
218                                float max = min + params.maxOffset;
219                                min += params.minOffset;
220                                
221                                float f = min/(Math.max(1f, max));
222                                f = Math.max(0.1f, f * 0.75f);
223                                
224                                // there's definitely a smarter way than this to get a uniform distribution -am
225                                float r = -1f;
226                                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
227                                        float test = (float) Math.sqrt(Math.random());
228                                        if (test >= f) {
229                                                r = test;
230                                                break;
231                                        }
232                                }
233                                if (r < 0f) {
234                                        r = f + (1f - f) * (float) Math.random();
235                                }
236                                
237                                //dir.scale(min + (max - min) * r);
238                                //r = f;
239                                dir.scale(max * r);
240                                offset = dir;
241                                offset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(offset, -attachedTo.getFacing());
242//                              if (params.spawnOffsetMultForInitialSpawn != params.spawnOffsetMult) {
243//                                      offset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(offset, (float) Math.random() * 360f);
244//                                      
245//                              }
246                                //offset = new Vector2f(200f, 0f);
247                        } else {
248                                offset = Misc.getPointWithinRadiusUniform(new Vector2f(), params.minOffset, params.maxOffset, Misc.random);
249                        }
250                        
251                        if (params.offsetModifier != null) {
252                                params.offsetModifier.modifyOffset(this);
253                        }
254                }
255                
256                public void advance(float amount, RoilingSwarmParams params) {
257                        loc.x += vel.x * amount;
258                        loc.y += vel.y * amount;
259                        
260                        angle += turnRate * amount;
261                        
262                        dur -= amount;
263                        if (dur <= 0) fader.fadeOut();
264                        
265                        recentlyPicked -= amount;
266                        if (recentlyPicked < 0) recentlyPicked = 0f;
267
268                        fader.advance(amount);
269                        if (flash != null) {
270                                flash.advance(amount * params.flashRateMult);
271                                if (flash.isFadedOut()) {
272                                        flash = null;
273                                }
274                        }
275                        if (flash == null && flashNext != null) {
276                                flash = flashNext;
277                                flashNext = null;
278                        }
279
280                        if (params.autoscale && !keepScale) {
281                                scaler.advance(amount * 0.5f);
282                                scale = minScale + (1f - minScale) * scaler.getBrightness() * scaler.getBrightness();
283                        }
284                }

286                public void flash() {
287                        if (flash == null) {
288                                flash = new FaderUtil(0f, 0.25f, 1f);
289                                flash.setBounceDown(true);
290                                flash.fadeIn();
291                        }
292                }
293                
294                public void flashNext() {
295                        flashNext = new FaderUtil(0f, 0.25f, 1f);
296                        flashNext.setBounceDown(true);
297                        flashNext.fadeIn();
298                }
299                
300                public void setRecentlyPicked(float pickDuration) {
301                        recentlyPicked = Math.max(recentlyPicked, pickDuration);
302                }
303        }

449        public void transferMembersTo(RoilingSwarmEffect other, int num, Vector2f point, float maxRangeFromPoint) {
450                if (num <= 0) return;
451                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = getPicker(true, true);
452                if (point != null) {
453                        picker = getPicker(true, true, point, maxRangeFromPoint);
454                }
455                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
456                        SwarmMember pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
457                        if (pick == null) break;
458                        
459                        removeMember(pick);
460                        other.addMember(pick);
461                        pick.rollOffset(other.params, other.attachedTo);
462                }
463        }

468        public void despawnMembers(int num, boolean allowFirst) {
469                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = getPicker(false, false);
470                if (!allowFirst && !members.isEmpty()) {
471                        picker.remove(members.get(0));
472                }
473                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
474                        SwarmMember pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
475                        if (pick == null) break;
476                        pick.fader.fadeOut();
477                }
478        }

488        public WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> getPicker(boolean preferNonFlashing, boolean preferNonPicked, 
489                                                                                                                Vector2f towards) {
490                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
491                float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(attachedTo.getLocation(), towards);
492                for (SwarmMember p : members) {
493                        if (p.fader.isFadingOut() || p.fader.isFadedOut()) continue;
494                        float w = 1000f;
495                        if (preferNonFlashing && p.flash != null) w *= 0.001f;
496                        if (preferNonPicked && p.recentlyPicked > 0) w *= 0.001f;
497                        
498                        float curr = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(attachedTo.getLocation(), p.loc);
499                        float diff = Misc.getAngleDiff(angle, curr);
500                        if (diff > 90f) {
501                                float f = Misc.normalizeAngle(diff - 90f) / 90f;
502                                if (f > 0.9999f) f = 0.9999f;
503                                w *= 1f - f;
504                                w *= 0.05f;
505                        }
506                        
507                        picker.add(p, w);
508                }
509                return picker;
510        }
511        public WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> getPicker(boolean preferNonFlashing, boolean preferNonPicked, 
512                                                                                                Vector2f point, float preferMaxRangeFromPoint) {
513                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
514                for (SwarmMember p : members) {
515                        if (p.fader.isFadingOut() || p.fader.isFadedOut()) continue;
516                        float w = 1000f;
517                        if (preferNonFlashing && p.flash != null) w *= 0.001f;
518                        if (preferNonPicked && p.recentlyPicked > 0) w *= 0.001f;
519                        
520                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(point, p.loc);
521                        if (dist > preferMaxRangeFromPoint) {
522                                float f = (dist - preferMaxRangeFromPoint) / Math.max(1f, preferMaxRangeFromPoint);
523                                if (f > 0.9999f) f = 0.9999f;
524                                w *= 1f - f;
525                        } else {
526                                w *= 0.25f + 0.75f * (1f - dist / Math.max(1f, preferMaxRangeFromPoint));
527                        }
528                        
529                        picker.add(p, w);
530                }
531                return picker;
532        }
533        public WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> getPicker(boolean preferNonFlashing, boolean preferNonPicked) {
534                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
535                for (SwarmMember p : members) {
536                        if (p.fader.isFadingOut() || p.fader.isFadedOut()) continue;
537                        float w = 1000f;
538                        if (preferNonFlashing && p.flash != null) w *= 0.001f;
539                        if (preferNonPicked && p.recentlyPicked > 0) w *= 0.001f;
540                        picker.add(p, w);
541                }
542                return picker;
543        }

562        public void advance(float amount) {
563                //if (true) return;
564                
565                if (Global.getCombatEngine().isPaused() || entity == null || isExpired()) return;
566                
567                if (!spawnedInitial && params.withInitialMembers) {
568                        float origSpawnOffsetMult = params.spawnOffsetMult;
569                        if (params.spawnOffsetMultForInitialSpawn >= 0) {
570                                params.spawnOffsetMult = params.spawnOffsetMultForInitialSpawn;
571                        }
572                        addMembers(params.initialMembers - getNumActiveMembers());
573                        params.spawnOffsetMult = origSpawnOffsetMult;
574                        spawnedInitial = true;
575                }
576                
577                if (attachedTo instanceof ShipAPI) {
578                        ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) attachedTo;
579                        amount *= ship.getMutableStats().getTimeMult().getModifiedValue();
580                }
581                
582//              attachedTo.setCollisionClass(CollisionClass.SHIP);
583//              ((ShipAPI)attachedTo).getMutableStats().getHullDamageTakenMult().modifyMult("efwefwefwe", 0f);
584                
585                //System.out.println("Swarm members: " + members.size());
586                
587                entity.getLocation().set(attachedTo.getLocation());
588
589                elapsed += amount;
590                
591                Vector2f aVel = attachedTo.getVelocity();
592                float aSpeed = aVel.length();
593                float leadAmount = aSpeed * params.swarmLeadsByFractionOfVelocity;
594                
595                Vector2f facingDir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(attachedTo.getFacing());
596                if (attachedTo.getVelocity().length() > 1f) {
597                        facingDir = Misc.normalise(new Vector2f(attachedTo.getVelocity()));
598                }
599                
600                Vector2f aLoc = new Vector2f(attachedTo.getLocation());
601//              if (params.generateOffsetAroundAttachedEntityOval && attachedTo instanceof ShipAPI) {
602//                      ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) attachedTo;
603//                      aLoc = new Vector2f(ship.getShieldCenterEvenIfNoShield());
604//              }
605                
606                List<SwarmMember> remove = new ArrayList<>();
607
608                float maxSpeed = params.maxSpeed;
609                if (params.outspeedAttachedEntityBy != 0) {
610                        float minMaxSpeed = attachedTo.getVelocity().length() + params.outspeedAttachedEntityBy;
611                        if (minMaxSpeed > maxSpeed) maxSpeed = minMaxSpeed;
612                }
613                
614                // springs! (sort of, sqrt instead of linear) and friction
615                boolean despawnAll = shouldDespawnAll();
616                
617                float maxOffsetForProx = params.maxOffset;
618                if (params.generateOffsetAroundAttachedEntityOval) {
619                        maxOffsetForProx += attachedTo.getCollisionRadius() * 0.75f;
620                }
621                
622                
623//              int flashing = 0;
624//              for (SwarmMember p : members) {
625//                      if (p.flash != null) flashing++;
626//              }
627//              System.out.println("Flashing: " + flashing + " / " + members.size());
628                
629                float maxDistSq = 0f;
630                maxDistFromCenterToFragment = 0f;
631                for (SwarmMember p : members) {
632                        float distSq = (aLoc.x - p.loc.x) * (aLoc.x - p.loc.x) + (aLoc.y - p.loc.y) * (aLoc.y - p.loc.y);
633                        maxDistSq = Math.max(maxDistSq, distSq);
634                        if (params.despawnDist > 0 && params.despawnDist * params.despawnDist < distSq) {
635                                p.fader.fadeOut();
636                        }
637                                        
638                        if (!despawnAll) {
639                                Vector2f offset = new Vector2f(p.offset);
640                                //offset.y *= p.offsetDrift;
641                                //offset.y = p.offsetDrift * params.maxOffset;
642                                //offset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(offset, attachedTo.getFacing() + elapsed * 5f);
643                                
644                                float prox = offset.length() / maxOffsetForProx;
645                                prox = 1f - prox;
646                                
647                                
648                                offset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(offset, attachedTo.getFacing() + elapsed * params.offsetRotationDegreesPerSecond);
649                                //offset = Misc.rotateAroundOrigin(offset, attachedTo.getFacing());
650                                offset.x += facingDir.x * leadAmount;
651                                offset.y += facingDir.y * leadAmount;
652                                
653                                if (!params.keepProxBasedScaleForAllMembers) {
654                                        p.scale = params.baseScale + (1f - prox) * params.scaleRange;
655                                        if (p.scale > 1f) p.scale = 1f;
656                                }
657                                
658                                Vector2f dest = new Vector2f(aLoc);
659                                Vector2f.add(dest, offset, dest);
660                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(p.loc, dest);
661                                
662                                Vector2f dirToDest = Misc.getUnitVector(p.loc, dest);
663                                Vector2f perp = new Vector2f(-dirToDest.y, dirToDest.x);
664                                
665                                float friction = params.baseFriction + params.frictionRange * prox;
666                                
667                                float k = params.baseSpringConstant - params.springConstantNegativeRange * prox;
668                                float freeLength = params.baseSpringFreeLength + params.springFreeLengthRange * prox;
669                                
670        //                      if (proj == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip()) {
671        //                              System.out.println("32ferfwefw");
672        //                      }
673                                
674                                float stretch = dist - freeLength;
675        
676                                stretch = (float) (Math.sqrt(Math.abs(stretch * params.springStretchMult)) * Math.signum(stretch));
677                                
678                                float forceMag = k * Math.abs(stretch);
679                                if (stretch < 0) forceMag = 0; // one-way spring, only pulls 
680                                
681                                float forceMagReduction = Math.min(Math.abs(forceMag), friction);
682                                forceMag -= forceMagReduction;
683                                friction -= forceMagReduction;
684                                
685                                
686                                Vector2f force = new Vector2f(dirToDest);
687                                force.scale(forceMag * Math.signum(stretch));
688                                
689                                Vector2f acc = new Vector2f(force);
690                                acc.scale(amount);
691                                Vector2f.add(p.vel, acc, p.vel);
692                                
693                                // leftover friction - apply against current velocity
694                                if (friction > 0) {
695                                        float relSpeed = Vector2f.sub(aVel, p.vel, new Vector2f()).length();
696                                        if (relSpeed > params.minSpeedForFriction) {
697                                                Vector2f frictionDec = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(Misc.getAngleInDegrees(p.vel));
698                                                frictionDec.negate();
699                                                frictionDec.scale(Math.min(friction, p.vel.length()) * amount); 
700                                                Vector2f.add(p.vel, frictionDec, p.vel);
701                                        }
702                                }
703                                
704                                // lateral friction to damp out any orbiting behavior fast
705                                float lateralSpeed = Math.abs(Vector2f.dot(p.vel, perp));
706                                if (lateralSpeed > 0) {// && lateralSpeed > params.minSpeedForFriction) {
707                                        Vector2f frictionDec = new Vector2f(perp);
708                                        if (Vector2f.dot(frictionDec, p.vel) > 0) {
709                                                frictionDec.negate();
710                                        }
711                                        float lateralFactor = params.lateralFrictionFactor;
712                                        lateralFactor += Math.min(Math.abs(attachedTo.getAngularVelocity()), 100f) * params.lateralFrictionTurnRateFactor;
713                                        float lateralFriction = lateralSpeed * lateralFactor;
714                                        frictionDec.scale(Math.min(lateralFriction, p.vel.length()) * amount); 
715                                        Vector2f.add(p.vel, frictionDec, p.vel);
716                                }
717                                
718                        
719                                
720                                float speed = p.vel.length();
721                                if (speed > maxSpeed) {
722                                        p.vel.scale(maxSpeed / speed);
723                                }
724                                
725                        }
726                        
727                        p.advance(amount, params);
728                        //p.loc.set(dest);
729                        
730                        if (despawnAll) {
731                                if (!p.fader.isFadingOut() && !p.fader.isFadedOut()) {
732                                        //p.fader.setDurationOut(2f + (float) Math.random() * 1f);
733                                        p.fader.setDurationOut(params.minDespawnTime + 
734                                                                        (params.maxDespawnTime - params.minDespawnTime) * (float) Math.random());
735                                        p.fader.fadeOut();
736                                }
737                        }
738                        
739                        
740                        if (p.fader.isFadedOut()) {
741                                remove.add(p);
742                        }
743                }
744                
745                maxDistFromCenterToFragment = (float) Math.sqrt(maxDistSq);
746                
747                members.removeAll(remove);
748                
749                if (despawnAll) {
750                        if (!despawning) {
751                                if (params.despawnSound != null) {
752                                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound(params.despawnSound, 1f, 1f, entity.getLocation(), aVel);
753                                        despawning = true;
754                                }
755                        }
756                }
757                
758                if (isExpired()) {
759//                      getShipMap().remove(attachedTo);
760//                      getFlockingMap().remove(params.flockingClass, this);
761//                      getExchangeMap().remove(params.memberExchangeClass, this);
762                } else if (!despawnAll && !despawning){
763                        exchangeWithNearbySwarms(amount);
764                }
765                
766                
767                if (!despawnAll) {
768                        respawnChecker.advance(amount * params.memberRespawnRate);
769                        if (respawnChecker.intervalElapsed() && params.withRespawn) {
770                                int num = getNumMembersToMaintain();
771                                if (members.size() < num) {
772                                        int add = Math.min(params.numToRespawn, num - members.size());
773                                        addMembers(add);
774                                        
775                                        if (params.offsetRerollFractionOnMemberRespawn > 0f) {
776                                                int reroll = Math.round(params.offsetRerollFractionOnMemberRespawn * members.size());
777                                                if (reroll < 1) reroll = 1;
778                                                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = getPicker(true, false);
779                                                for (int i = 0; i < reroll; i++) {
780                                                        SwarmMember pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
781                                                        if (pick == null) break;
782                                                        pick.rollOffset(params, attachedTo);
783                                                }
784                                        }
785                                        
786                                } else if (members.size() > num && params.removeMembersAboveMaintainLevel) {
787                                        despawnMembers(1);
788                                } else if (params.maxNumMembersToAlwaysRemoveAbove >= 0 &&
789                                                members.size() > params.maxNumMembersToAlwaysRemoveAbove) {
790                                        int extra = members.size() - params.maxNumMembersToAlwaysRemoveAbove;
791                                        int numRemove = (int) Math.min(extra * 0.1f, 5f);
792                                        if (numRemove < 1) numRemove = 1;
793                                        despawnMembers(numRemove);
794                                }
795                        }
796                        
797                        
798                        flashChecker.advance(amount * params.flashFrequency);
799                        params.preFlashDelay -= amount;
800                        if (params.preFlashDelay < 0) params.preFlashDelay = 0;
801                        if (flashChecker.intervalElapsed() && params.preFlashDelay <= 0) {
802                                if (params.flashProbability > 0) {
803                                        WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> notFlashing = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
804                                        for (SwarmMember p : members) {
805                                                if (p.flash == null) {
806                                                        notFlashing.add(p);
807                                                }
808                                        }
809                                        for (int i = 0; i < params.numToFlash; i++) {
810                                                if ((float) Math.random() < params.flashProbability) {
811                                                        SwarmMember pick = notFlashing.pickAndRemove();
812                                                        if (pick != null) pick.flash();
813                                                }
814                                        }
815                                }
816                        }
817                }
818                
819                sinceExchange += amount;
820//              if (proj.didDamage()) {
821//                      if (!resetTrailSpeed) {
822//                              for (ParticleData p : particles) {
823//                                      Vector2f.add(p.vel, projVel, p.vel);
824//                              }
825//                              projVel.scale(0f);
826//                              resetTrailSpeed = true;
827//                      }
828//                      for (ParticleData p : particles) {
829//                              float dist = p.offset.length();
830//                              p.vel.scale(Math.min(1f, dist / 100f));
831//                      }
832//              }
833        }

835        public void exchangeWithNearbySwarms(float amount) {
836                if (params.memberExchangeClass == null || params.memberExchangeRange <= 0) return;
837                
838                transferChecker.advance(amount * params.memberExchangeRate);
839                if (!transferChecker.intervalElapsed()) return;
840                
841                
842                WeightedRandomPicker<RoilingSwarmEffect> swarmPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<>();
843                
844                for (RoilingSwarmEffect other : getExchangeMap().getList(params.memberExchangeClass)) {
845                        if (other == this || other.getEntity() == null || other.despawning) continue;
846                        if (other.attachedTo == null || attachedTo == null) continue;
847                        if (other.attachedTo.getOwner() != attachedTo.getOwner()) continue;
848                        
849                        if (other.params.memberExchangeClass == null ||
850                                        !other.params.memberExchangeClass.equals(params.memberExchangeClass)) {
851                                continue;
852                        }
853                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(entity.getLocation(), other.getEntity().getLocation());
854                        if (dist > params.memberExchangeRange) continue;
855                        
856                        swarmPicker.add(other);
857                }
858                        
859                RoilingSwarmEffect other = swarmPicker.pick();
860                if (other == null) return;
861                        
862                int num = params.minMembersToExchange + 
863                                Misc.random.nextInt(params.maxMembersToExchange - params.minMembersToExchange + 1);
864                
865                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> picker = getPicker(true, true);
866                WeightedRandomPicker<SwarmMember> pickerOther = other.getPicker(true, true);
867                
868                num = Math.min(num, picker.getItems().size());
869                num = Math.min(num, pickerOther.getItems().size());
870                
871                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
872                        SwarmMember pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
873                        SwarmMember otherPick = pickerOther.pickAndRemove();
874                        if (pick == null || otherPick == null) break;
875                        
876                        removeMember(pick);
877                        other.addMember(pick);
878                        pick.rollOffset(other.params, other.attachedTo);
879                        
880                        other.removeMember(otherPick);
881                        addMember(otherPick);
882                        otherPick.rollOffset(params, attachedTo);
883                        
884                        sinceExchange = 0f;
885                }
886                
887        }

890        public boolean shouldDespawnAll() {
891                if (forceDespawn) return true;
892                
893//              if ((float) Math.random() > 0.9995f && !params.generateOffsetAroundAttachedEntityOval) {
894//                      forceDespawn = true;
895//                      return true;
896//              }
897                
898                if (attachedTo instanceof ShipAPI) {
899                        ShipAPI ship = (ShipAPI) attachedTo;
900                        return !Global.getCombatEngine().isShipAlive(ship);
901                }
902                if (attachedTo instanceof MissileAPI) {
903                        MissileAPI missile = (MissileAPI) attachedTo;
904                        return !Global.getCombatEngine().isMissileAlive(missile);
905                }
906                
907                return attachedTo.isExpired() || !Global.getCombatEngine().isEntityInPlay(attachedTo);
908        }

910        public boolean isExpired() {
911                boolean expired = shouldDespawnAll() && members.isEmpty();
912                if (expired) {
913                        //getFlockingMap().getList(FragmentSwarmHullmod.STANDARD_SWARM_FLOCKING_CLASS).get(0)
914                        getShipMap().remove(attachedTo);
915                        getFlockingMap().remove(params.flockingClass, this);
916                        getExchangeMap().remove(params.memberExchangeClass, this);
917                }
918                return expired;
919        }
